The Kitchen — Designed for Kashrut

The chef's kitchen at 9432 Oakmore Rd was built with kosher observance in mind. Dual sinks (one designated meat, one dairy) and dual ovens give a halachically clear separation of food preparation zones. The double-thickness counters allow for two simultaneous meal preps without contact between the surfaces. The pantry has divided shelving for parve, meat, and dairy storage with separate labeled drawers.

The dishwasher is positioned to be designated for one designation (typically dairy in observant households), and a secondary dish sink supports the second. Tenants taking a long-term lease are welcome to install a second dishwasher at their cost — the cabinetry has been pre-plumbed for it.

For Pesach changeover, the kitchen design makes kashering relatively simple: the granite counters are heat-resistant, the metal sinks accept boiling-water purification, and the oven self-clean cycle reaches the temperatures required for halachic kashering. Tenants are welcome to bring or store Pesach-specific cookware and dishware.

The property sits inside the Los Angeles Community Eruv (LACE) which covers the Beverlywood, Pico-Robertson, and Beverly Hills South corridors. Confirm current Eruv status weekly at the Eruv hotline before Shabbat.

Kosher Food Corridor — Pico & Robertson

9432 Oakmore Rd sits at the intersection of the two largest kosher commercial corridors in Los Angeles. Pico Boulevard (5-min drive, 1.2 mi south) is home to dozens of kosher restaurants and bakeries: Pat's, Jeff's Gourmet, Pico Cafe, La Gondola, Got Kosher, La Brea Bagel, and Sassi. Robertson Boulevard (5-min drive, 1.0 mi east) covers the upscale kosher strip with Tierra Sur, Bibi's Bakery, and Western Kosher.

Kosher grocers within 10 minutes: Whole Foods Beverly Hills (full kosher meat section, 5 mi), Glatt Mart (full kosher market, 1.5 mi), Western Kosher (1.0 mi), Cambridge Farms Market (1.7 mi), Pico Glatt Mart (1.3 mi). Premium kosher butchers: Western Kosher and Glatt Mart both offer same-day cuts.

For Shabbat catering and pre-cooked meals, the Pico corridor offers Sunday-Friday pickup from multiple shops with delivery to Beverlywood. Several caterers maintain pre-Shabbat hot meal pickup programs aligned to candle-lighting times.
